intro.en: Errors 11–15: singular verbs after everybody, one of, every and the number of - plus despite.
intro.bn: ভুল ১১–১৫: everybody, one of, every আর the number of-এর পরে singular verb - সাথে despite।

learned.en: Everybody, everyone, each, neither take a singular verb
learned.bn: Everybody, everyone, each, neither-এর পরে singular verb

learned.en: One of + plural noun + singular verb
learned.bn: One of + plural noun + singular verb

learned.en: Every + singular noun; the number of + singular verb
learned.bn: Every + singular noun; the number of + singular verb

learned.en: Despite (no of) vs in spite of
learned.bn: Despite (of ছাড়া) বনাম in spite of

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: One of my friend is studying in Canada.
One of my friends are studying in Canada.
One of my friends is studying in Canada.

explain.en: After one of, the noun is plural (my friends), but the verb stays singular because the true subject is one.
explain.bn: One of-এর পরে noun plural (my friends), কিন্তু verb singular থাকে, কারণ আসল subject হলো one।

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: The number of road accidents are increasing every year.
The number of road accidents is increasing every year.

explain.en: The subject is number (singular), not accidents. A number of, meaning “several”, is different and takes a plural verb.
explain.bn: Subject হলো number (singular), accidents নয়। A number of মানে “several” - ওটা আলাদা, তার পরে plural verb।

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: Despite of the heavy rain, the ceremony continued.
In spite of the heavy rain, the ceremony continued.
Despite it rained heavily, the ceremony continued.

explain.en: Despite takes no of; in spite of keeps it. Both take a noun or -ing form, never a full clause - for a clause, use although.
explain.bn: Despite-এর পরে of বসে না; in spite of-এ of থাকে। দুটোর পরেই noun বা -ing রূপ, কখনো পূর্ণ clause নয় - clause-এর জন্য although।

intro.en: Errors 16–20: redundant doubles, cope with, comprise, and tenses with time expressions.
intro.bn: ভুল ১৬–২০: অপ্রয়োজনীয় দ্বিরুক্তি, cope with, comprise, আর সময়ের শব্দের সাথে tense।

learned.en: Return, not return back
learned.bn: Return - return back নয়

learned.en: Cope with; comprise vs consist of
learned.bn: Cope with; comprise বনাম consist of

learned.en: Finished time → simple past
learned.bn: শেষ হয়ে যাওয়া সময় → simple past

learned.en: Since/for → present perfect
learned.bn: Since/for → present perfect

prompt.en: Which sentence avoids redundancy?

options.en: After his studies, he returned back to his hometown.
After his studies, he returned to his hometown.

explain.en: Return already means “go back”, so back is redundant. The same goes for repeat again, revert back and ascend up.
explain.bn: Return মানেই “go back”, তাই back বাড়তি। Repeat again, revert back, ascend up-এর বেলাতেও একই কথা।

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: The committee comprises of twelve senior members.
The committee consists of twelve senior members.
The committee consists twelve senior members.

explain.en: Comprise takes no of; the of belongs to consist of and be composed of. Never mix them into comprises of.
explain.bn: Comprise-এর পরে of বসে না; of থাকে consist of আর be composed of-এ। দুটো মিশিয়ে comprises of লিখবেন না।

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: I am living in Dhaka since 2015.
I have been living in Dhaka since 2015.

explain.en: A duration that started in the past and continues now needs the present perfect (continuous). Since and for are the signal words.
explain.bn: অতীতে শুরু হয়ে এখনো চলছে এমন সময়ের জন্য present perfect (continuous) লাগে। Since আর for হলো সংকেত-শব্দ।

intro.en: Errors 21–25: tell vs say, opinion phrases, most people, sitting an exam, and do vs make.
intro.bn: ভুল ২১–২৫: tell বনাম say, মতামতের phrase, most people, exam দেওয়া, আর do বনাম make।

learned.en: Tell someone; say something to someone
learned.bn: Tell someone; say something to someone

learned.en: In my opinion, not according to me
learned.bn: In my opinion - according to me নয়

learned.en: Most / the majority of, not maximum
learned.bn: Most / the majority of - maximum নয়

learned.en: Sit or take an exam; make a mistake
learned.bn: Sit বা take an exam; make a mistake

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: My friend told to me that the interview went well.
My friend said me that the interview went well.
My friend told me that the interview went well.

explain.en: Tell takes a person directly (tell me). Say needs to before a person (say to me).
explain.bn: Tell সরাসরি ব্যক্তিকে নেয় (tell me)। Say-এর পরে ব্যক্তির আগে to লাগে (say to me)।

prompt.en: Which phrase introduces your own view?

explain.en: According to introduces an external source, such as according to the report. For your own view, use in my opinion or from my perspective.
explain.bn: According to বাইরের কোনো উৎস বোঝায়, যেমন according to the report। নিজের মতের জন্য in my opinion বা from my perspective।

prompt.en: Which collocation is correct?

explain.en: You make a mistake, a decision, progress, an effort; you do homework, research, a favour. Bangla করা covers both, so learn them as fixed pairs.
explain.bn: Make a mistake, a decision, progress, an effort; কিন্তু do homework, research, a favour। বাংলায় করা দুটোই বোঝায়, তাই জোড়াগুলো মুখস্থ রাখুন।

intro.en: Errors 26–30: since vs for, turning devices on and off, all my, introducing yourself, and graduate.
intro.bn: ভুল ২৬–৩০: since বনাম for, যন্ত্র on/off করা, all my, নিজের পরিচয় দেওয়া, আর graduate।

learned.en: Since + point in time; for + length of time
learned.bn: Since + সময়ের বিন্দু; for + সময়ের দৈর্ঘ্য

learned.en: Turn on / turn off the light and fan
learned.bn: Light আর fan-এর জন্য turn on / turn off

learned.en: All my relatives; I am Rahim
learned.bn: All my relatives; I am Rahim

learned.en: Graduate from, not pass out from
learned.bn: Graduate from - pass out from নয়

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: I have not met my school friends since a long time.
I have not met my school friends for a long time.

explain.en: Since needs a starting point (since 2015). “A long time” is a length of time, so it takes for.
explain.bn: Since-এর পরে শুরুর সময় (since 2015)। “A long time” হলো সময়ের দৈর্ঘ্য, তাই for।

prompt.en: Pick the natural English sentence.

options.en: My all relatives gathered for the wedding celebration.
All my relatives gathered for the wedding celebration.

explain.en: In English, all comes before the possessive: all my relatives, all his money. The same holds for both my parents.
explain.bn: English-এ all বসে possessive-এর আগে: all my relatives, all his money। Both my parents-এর বেলাতেও তাই।

prompt.en: In standard English, what does “pass out” mean?

options.bn: University degree শেষ করা
অজ্ঞান হয়ে যাওয়া

explain.en: Pass out means to faint. To complete a degree, say graduated from - a false friend, not a grammar error.
explain.bn: Pass out মানে অজ্ঞান হওয়া। Degree শেষ করা বোঝাতে graduated from বলুন - এটা false friend, grammar-এর ভুল নয়।

intro.en: Fifteen hidden L1 errors to spot and fix, then ten Bangla thoughts to put into natural English.
intro.bn: লুকানো ১৫টি L1 ভুল খুঁজে ঠিক করুন, তারপর ১০টি বাংলা চিন্তাকে স্বাভাবিক English-এ লিখুন।

learned.en: Spot and fix the core L1 errors
learned.bn: মূল L1 ভুলগুলো খুঁজে ঠিক করা

learned.en: Translate the meaning, not the words
learned.bn: শব্দ নয়, অর্থ অনুবাদ করা

learned.en: Attempt first, then check the key
learned.bn: আগে নিজে চেষ্টা, তারপর key দেখা

prompt.en: What should you do before checking the answer key?
prompt.bn: Answer key দেখার আগে কী করবেন?

options.en: Read the key first, then try the sentences
options.bn: আগে key পড়ে তারপর বাক্যগুলো চেষ্টা করা

options.en: Attempt both exercises fully with a pen
options.bn: কলম হাতে দুটো exercise পুরোপুরি করে ফেলা

explain.en: Do not read the key first: recognition is not the same as production.
explain.bn: আগে key পড়বেন না: চিনতে পারা আর নিজে লিখতে পারা এক জিনিস নয়।

prompt.en: How should you turn each Bangla thought into English?
prompt.bn: প্রতিটা বাংলা চিন্তাকে কীভাবে English-এ লিখবেন?

options.bn: শব্দে শব্দে অনুবাদ করে

options.en: Translate the meaning in one natural sentence
options.bn: অর্থটা একটা স্বাভাবিক বাক্যে অনুবাদ করে

explain.en: Translate the meaning, not the words - word-for-word translation is exactly what produces L1 errors.
explain.bn: শব্দ নয়, অর্থ অনুবাদ করুন - শব্দে শব্দে অনুবাদ থেকেই তো L1 ভুল তৈরি হয়।

intro.en: Why vague words cap your band, and how the upgrade ladder works.
intro.bn: অস্পষ্ট শব্দ কেন আপনার band আটকে রাখে, আর upgrade-এর সিঁড়ি কীভাবে কাজ করে।

learned.en: Overused words are vague, not wrong
learned.bn: বেশি-ব্যবহৃত শব্দ ভুল নয়, অস্পষ্ট

learned.en: The Band 5.5 → 7.5 → 9.0 ladder
Selection: one precise word, not a pile of rare ones
learned.bn: বাছাই: একটা নির্ভুল শব্দ, অনেক দুর্লভ শব্দের স্তূপ নয়

prompt.en: What caps Lexical Resource at Band 6?
prompt.bn: Lexical Resource-কে Band 6-এ কী আটকে রাখে?

options.en: Vague overused words like big, good and thing
options.bn: big, good, thing-এর মতো অস্পষ্ট, বেশি-ব্যবহৃত শব্দ

options.en: Not using rare words in every sentence
options.bn: প্রতিটা বাক্যে দুর্লভ শব্দ না রাখা

explain.en: These words are not wrong - they are vague, and vagueness caps Lexical Resource at Band 6. The examiner wants the right word, not a rare one.
explain.bn: এই শব্দগুলো ভুল নয় - অস্পষ্ট, আর অস্পষ্টতাই Lexical Resource-কে Band 6-এ আটকে রাখে। Examiner চান সঠিক শব্দ, দুর্লভ শব্দ নয়।

prompt.en: Which approach do examiners penalise?

options.en: One precise word where a vague one used to sit
options.bn: অস্পষ্ট শব্দের জায়গায় একটা নির্ভুল শব্দ

options.en: A script stuffed with plethora, myriad and paradigm
options.bn: plethora, myriad, paradigm দিয়ে ঠাসা লেখা

explain.en: A stuffed script reads as memorised and unnatural. Range plus accuracy, not range at the cost of it.
explain.bn: ঠাসা লেখা মুখস্থ আর অস্বাভাবিক শোনায়। Range-এর সাথে accuracy - accuracy হারিয়ে range নয়।

intro.en: Upgrades for big, small, good, bad and important - and where each one belongs.
intro.bn: big, small, good, bad আর important-এর upgrade - আর কোনটা কোথায় মানায়।

learned.en: Large for size; substantial for amounts; significant for importance
learned.bn: Size-এ large; পরিমাণে substantial; গুরুত্বে significant

learned.en: Beneficial, detrimental, adverse effect on
learned.bn: Beneficial, detrimental, adverse effect on

learned.en: Crucial, vital, essential, paramount
learned.bn: Crucial, vital, essential, paramount

learned.en: Huge and terrible are fine in Speaking, not in Task 2
learned.bn: Huge, terrible Speaking-এ চলে, Task 2-এ নয়

prompt.en: Writing Task 2: “Dhaka has a ___ population.” Which word fits best?
prompt.bn: Writing Task 2: “Dhaka has a ___ population.” কোন শব্দটা সবচেয়ে মানানসই?

explain.en: In Task 2, avoid big, huge and massive. Substantial and considerable are for amounts.
explain.bn: Task 2-এ big, huge, massive এড়িয়ে চলুন। পরিমাণ বোঝাতে substantial আর considerable।

prompt.en: Which is the strong academic phrase for harm?
prompt.bn: ক্ষতি বোঝাতে কোনটা শক্তিশালী academic phrase?

explain.en: Detrimental to and adverse effect on are the strong academic collocations for harm. Write a detrimental effect, not a bad effect.
explain.bn: ক্ষতি বোঝাতে detrimental to আর adverse effect on হলো শক্তিশালী academic collocation। Bad effect নয়, detrimental effect লিখুন।

prompt.en: Which word means “most important of all”?

explain.en: Paramount means most important of all. Essential is something you cannot do without; key and crucial mean decisive.
explain.bn: Paramount মানে সবকিছুর চেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। Essential মানে যা ছাড়া চলে না; key আর crucial মানে নির্ণায়ক।

intro.en: Upgrades for difficult, dangerous, rich and beautiful.
intro.bn: difficult, dangerous, rich আর beautiful-এর upgrade।

learned.en: Challenging, demanding, arduous, daunting
learned.bn: Challenging, demanding, arduous, daunting

learned.en: Hazardous to; detrimental to health
learned.bn: Hazardous to; detrimental to health

learned.en: Affluent, prosperous, developed nations
learned.bn: Affluent, prosperous, developed nations

learned.en: Scenic, charming, picturesque - mostly Speaking
learned.bn: Scenic, charming, picturesque - মূলত Speaking-এ

prompt.en: Which word means “long and tiring”?

explain.en: Arduous means long and tiring. Formidable means seriously difficult to overcome; daunting means intimidating to face.
explain.bn: Arduous মানে দীর্ঘ আর ক্লান্তিকর। Formidable মানে কাটিয়ে ওঠা সত্যিই কঠিন; daunting মানে মুখোমুখি হতে ভয় লাগে এমন।

prompt.en: Which sentence uses the academic choice for Writing?
prompt.bn: Writing-এর জন্য academic শব্দ কোন বাক্যে?

options.en: Rich countries should help poor countries.
Affluent nations should support developing ones.

explain.en: Affluent and prosperous are the academic choices in Writing; well-off is natural in Speaking.
explain.bn: Writing-এ affluent আর prosperous হলো academic পছন্দ; Speaking-এ well-off স্বাভাবিক।

prompt.en: Which word is used for natural views?

explain.en: Scenic is for natural views, charming for towns and villages, and elegant for design.
explain.bn: প্রাকৃতিক দৃশ্যের জন্য scenic, শহর-গ্রামের জন্য charming, আর design-এর জন্য elegant।

intro.en: Upgrades for happy, interesting, increase, decrease and solve.
intro.bn: happy, interesting, increase, decrease আর solve-এর upgrade।

learned.en: Pleased (a reaction) vs content (a lasting state)
learned.bn: Pleased (প্রতিক্রিয়া) বনাম content (স্থায়ী অবস্থা)

learned.en: Compelling argument, compelling evidence
learned.bn: Compelling argument, compelling evidence

learned.en: Rise/fall take no object; raise/reduce need one
learned.bn: Rise/fall object নেয় না; raise/reduce-এ object লাগে

learned.en: Tackle, address, eradicate, alleviate, mitigate
learned.bn: Tackle, address, eradicate, alleviate, mitigate

prompt.en: Which word describes a lasting state rather than a reaction?
prompt.bn: কোন শব্দটা প্রতিক্রিয়া নয়, স্থায়ী অবস্থা বোঝায়?

explain.en: Content and satisfied are for lasting states; pleased and glad are for reactions.
explain.bn: Content আর satisfied স্থায়ী অবস্থার জন্য; pleased আর glad প্রতিক্রিয়ার জন্য।

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

explain.en: Decline, fall and drop take no object; reduce and lower need one. “The price reduced” comes from কমা/কমানো blurring the two.
explain.bn: Decline, fall, drop object নেয় না; reduce আর lower-এ object লাগে। কমা/কমানো গুলিয়ে ফেলায় “the price reduced” ভুলটা হয়।

prompt.en: A problem can be wiped out completely. Which verb fits?
prompt.bn: কোনো সমস্যা পুরোপুরি নির্মূল করা যায়। কোন verb মানানসই?

explain.en: Eradicate means remove completely. Alleviate eases suffering; mitigate reduces severity.
explain.bn: Eradicate মানে পুরোপুরি দূর করা। Alleviate কষ্ট কমায়; mitigate তীব্রতা কমায়।

intro.en: Upgrades for change, help, show and cause.
intro.bn: change, help, show আর cause-এর upgrade।

learned.en: Modify, transform, revolutionise, overhaul
learned.bn: Modify, transform, revolutionise, overhaul

learned.en: Enable, facilitate, foster
learned.bn: Enable, facilitate, foster

learned.en: Indicate, reveal, illustrate, underscore
learned.bn: Indicate, reveal, illustrate, underscore

learned.en: Lead to, result in, contribute to, give rise to
learned.bn: Lead to, result in, contribute to, give rise to

prompt.en: Which verb means a complete change?

explain.en: Transform is a complete change. Modify is a small adjustment; shift is a change of direction.
explain.bn: Transform মানে সম্পূর্ণ পরিবর্তন। Modify ছোট সমন্বয়; shift দিক বদল।

prompt.en: Which verb means “draw attention to something important”?
prompt.bn: কোন verb মানে “গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কিছুর দিকে মনোযোগ টানা”?

explain.en: Highlight and underscore draw attention to something important. Reveal uncovers something not obvious; indicate is data pointing to a conclusion.
explain.bn: Highlight আর underscore গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কিছুর দিকে মনোযোগ টানে। Reveal অপ্রকাশ্য কিছু সামনে আনে; indicate মানে data কোনো সিদ্ধান্তের দিকে ইঙ্গিত করছে।

prompt.en: It is one cause among several. Which phrase fits?
prompt.bn: এটা কয়েকটা কারণের একটা। কোন phrase মানানসই?

explain.en: Use contribute to when it is one cause among several. Trigger means set off suddenly; precipitate means bring on abruptly.
explain.bn: অনেক কারণের একটা হলে contribute to। Trigger মানে হঠাৎ শুরু করে দেওয়া; precipitate মানে আচমকা ঘটিয়ে ফেলা।

intro.en: Upgrades for improve, affect, use, get and want.
intro.bn: improve, affect, use, get আর want-এর upgrade।

learned.en: Enhance, boost, refine, optimise
learned.bn: Enhance, boost, refine, optimise

learned.en: Affect is the verb; effect is the noun
learned.bn: Affect হলো verb; effect হলো noun

learned.en: Employ, harness; obtain, acquire, secure
learned.bn: Employ, harness; obtain, acquire, secure

learned.en: Intend to, aspire to, seek to
learned.bn: Intend to, aspire to, seek to

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence.

options.en: Social media has a strong affect on young people.
Social media has a strong effect on young people.

explain.en: Affect is the verb, effect the noun: affect acts, effect is the result. After “a strong”, you need the noun.
explain.bn: Affect হলো verb, effect হলো noun: affect কাজ করে, effect হলো ফল। “a strong”-এর পরে noun লাগে।

prompt.en: Which verb suits something hard to get, like a scholarship?
